'''Flash''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Flash and several other [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Soldier/Legends|troopers]] assisted [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in evacuating the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Liberty (Venator-class)/Legends|''Liberty'']] after it was [[Sky Battle of Quell|attacked]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] forces over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quell/Legends|Quell]]. They rescued [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]], evacuating the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] aboard a [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. During the escape, the cruiser suffered damage, causing the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] to activate and subsequently crash the ship on the planet [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]]. On the surface, Flash&mdash;along with fellow clones [[Cameron/Legends|Cameron]] and [[Lucky/Legends|Lucky]]&mdash;were killed by [[Mastiff phalone/Legends|mastiff phalones]], predators native to the world.

==Biography==
Flash was the taken name of a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|trooper]],<ref name="jc" /> bred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] using [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] from the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] to serve the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="db" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="2011annual" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Flash was aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The ''Resolute'' answered a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] from the [[Liberty (Venator-class)/Legends|''Liberty'']], which was commanded by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]. On Skywalker's order, the ''Resolute'' jumped to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quell/Legends|Quell]], where Secura's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of three ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] were [[Sky Battle of Quell|engaged]] with a Separatist force consisting of four [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]]. The [[TF-1726/Legends|tactical droid]] in command of the Separatist flotilla ordered [[Rocket pack/Legends|rocket pack]]–equipped<ref name="jc" /> [[B2-RP battle droid/Legends|B2-RP battle droids]]<ref name="S1 Ep Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref> to board the ''Liberty''. With the ''Liberty'' heavily damaged and listing in Quell's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], Skywalker led his troops to Secura's vessel in [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] to evacuate the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. Flash, along with fellow [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Cameron/Legends|Cameron]] and [[Lucky/Legends|Lucky]], rode in Skywalker's gunship along with the general's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]].<ref name="jc" />

As the battle was raging in Quell's upper atmosphere, Skywalker jumped out of the gunship, using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to slow his descent. Shortly after, one of the Separatist B2-RP [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] disabled the gunship that Flash was traveling in, causing it to crash onto the hull of the ''Liberty''. Captain Rex and Tano led Flash and the other [[Soldier/Legends|troopers]] into the vessel using a breach in its hull, rendezvousing with General Skywalker. The group subsequently met up with General Secura and her clone [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]]. Skywalker had arranged for a [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] to dock in the ''Liberty''{{'s}} ventral [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], and he led the small group of Jedi and clones to be evacuated, fighting a running battle with [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] as they went. On route to the hangar, an explosion aboard the ''Liberty'' sent flames and concussive force down the corridors of the cruiser. The wavefront approached the group of Jedi and clones as they were about cross through the gangway to board the evacuation ship; seeing the danger, Skywalker used the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|push]] Flash and the rest of the group through the [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]]. As the cruiser's [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]] sealed in front and behind him, Skywalker tried to use the Force to contain the approaching blast. He failed, and the resulting impact blew the blast doors apart. Severely injured by flying debris, Skywalker was rescued by Tano and Secura&mdash;who had opened the blast doors leading to the rescue ship&mdash;just as the cruiser undocked from the ''Liberty''{{'s}} hangar.<ref name="jc" />

As the ''Consular''-class cruiser attempted to dock with the ''Resolute'', it came under fire from Separatist [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], resulting in its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] being triggered. The ship executed a [[Hyperspace/Legends|blind jump]], and ended up crashing onto the planet [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]]. Flash survived the crash-landing, and assisted the other survivors&mdash;Secura, Tano, Rex, Bly, Cameron and Lucky&mdash;in erecting a temporary camp and shelter to care for the injured Skywalker. Commander Bly discovered a small engraving on a stone table that indicated that the planet held [[Sentience/Legends|intelligent life]] near the campsite, and Secura was determined to locate them as Skywalker's condition was worsening and they needed medical aid to treat him.<ref name="jc" />

[[File:Jedi_and_clones.png|left|thumb|General Secura and Ahsoka Tano lead the clones in search of help for Master Skywalker.|244x244px]]
Leaving Rex to watch over Skywalker, Secura led the remaining clone troopers and Tano in search of the natives. During their search, the group came across a giant [[Tree/Legends|tree]] with large seedpods hanging from it. Some of the seedpods detached from the tree, causing the clones underneath it to scatter to avoid being crushed to [[Death/Legends|death]]. Secura noted that tracks from the tree indicated that an intelligent [[Species/Legends|species]] had dragged several of the seedpods away, and ordered the group to follow the trail. After night fell, Flash, along with the rest of the group, entered a small clearing surrounded by long [[Grass/Legends|grass]], where they were ambushed by three [[Mastiff phalone/Legends|mastiff phalones]], predators native to the planet. One beast caught Lucky in his midsection, tossing him high into the air, while another attacked Flash, jumping on them and using its powerful jaws to bite their neck through the gap in their [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]]. Although Bly managed to kill the predator with his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], Flash was already dead. The third creature killed Cameron, then tossed the corpse at Bly before retreating. Bly confirmed their deaths to Secura and Tano before the three left the bodies of the dead clones behind in the clearing to continue their search. Secura, Tano and Bly eventually found a [[Lurmen village/Legends|colony]] of [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] living on the planet who treated Skywalker's injuries.<ref name="jc" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of Jango Fett, Flash stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="db" /> They were equipped with Phase I clone trooper [[Armor/Legends|armor]], and their helmet was mounted with two flashlights, one on either side. They wielded a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]].<ref name="jc" />

==Behind the scenes==
Flash was introduced in ''[[Jedi Crash]]'', the thirteenth episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] in which they are killed. In the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|DVD]] subtitles for ''Jedi Crash'', Flash's name is misspelled as "Flesh".

Flash is never specifically identified on-screen during ''Jedi Crash'', and is one of three generic clone troopers present in the episode. While they and the other two (Cameron and Lucky) are only referred to by name on Maridun after the crash of the ''Consular''-class cruiser, three clone troopers are seen accompanying Skywalker, Tano and Rex on the LAAT gunship they use to board the ''Liberty''. The troopers are present with Rex in all subsequent scenes. Flash's name is only mentioned after they are killed by a mastiff phalone, and their corpse is not specifically identified. This article assumes that Flash and their compatriots were the clone troopers accompanying Rex, Tano and Skywalker during the battle. In addition, this article also assumes that the order in which Bly looks at the bodies and mentions the trooper's names indicates that Flash was the clone killed by the mastiff phalone which Bly killed during the ambush.
